resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1942 for a 30-foot tower; the Lincoln FPA annual reports describe a 40-foot cedar pole tower constructed in 1953 and say nothing about a 1942 tower. Story gives both dates and does not pick one.

30 feet (about 9.1 m) on the register and firelookout.com; 40 feet (12.2 m) in the 1953 annual report. The record keeps 12.2 m, the figure from the later report, and the story notes the 30-foot figure.
Removal date differs: dismantled 1969 per the annual reports, removed 1971 per the register, destroyed 1971 per firelookout.com. Story gives all three.

notes_for_editor: Three pages read; no fire, access or current-site record found, so none written. Access and visit keys omitted. Elevation not in facts: the brief gives 990.6 m (3,250 ft) but firelookout.com lists 3100 ft (about 945 m); not resolved, so check before using the brief's elevation. The 1953 annual report text is OCR-garbled in the ORWW PDF copy; quotes use the weebly page text. Agency is the Oregon Department of Forestry (Lincoln FPA district), not the US Forest Service.
